title: alchemilla vulgaris f. demissa
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris f. demissa, commonly known as lady's mantle, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating menstrual cramps, digestive issues, and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of lady's mantle are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and astringent properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of lady's mantle include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in treating various health conditions.
